lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity blobs are arranged in approximately seven distinct vertical columns; each column contains 3 to 5 roughly circular clusters. The spacing between columns remains relatively constant along the longitudinal axis of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the blob columns, forming a grid where the high-luminance blobs reside within the vertical stripe boundaries.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient where the dorsal edge exhibits peak luminance and the ventral edge transitions into low-intensity shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible segment of the dorsal fin in the upper-left quadrant contains a cluster of 5-7 high-luminance spots that are smaller in diameter and more irregularly spaced than those on the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are visible on the anterior right section of the frame, appearing as high-contrast shadow lines perpendicular to the longitudinal axis.
